description: This PHP script generates the Edit View for scheduling tasks in SuiteCRM, including form setup, JavaScript validation, and template rendering for scheduler configuration.

classes.name: javascript
classes.description: A class used for JavaScript validation and form handling in the view.

classes.name: XTemplate
classes.description: Template engine class used for rendering the HTML form for scheduler editing.

methods.name: setSugarBean
methods.description: Associates a SugarBean object with the JavaScript validation object.

methods.name: setFormName
methods.description: Sets the form name for JavaScript validation.

methods.name: addAllFields
methods.description: Adds all form fields for validation.

methods.name: addFieldGeneric
methods.description: Adds a generic field for validation with specific type and label.

methods.name: addToValidateBinaryDependency
methods.description: Adds validation for binary dependencies between two fields.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript code for validation.

methods.name: AMPMMenu
methods.description: Generates AM/PM dropdown menu for time selection.
